characters.desc: Nika, young adult female expedition navigator. Distinct short navy ponytail, cream brimmed explorer hat, orange neck scarf, white shirt, navy shorts/leggings, boots, binoculars hanging at her chest and small rolled map tucked into belt. Friendly confident adventurous.

characters.desc: Tim, young male expedition scout, a cheerful older teenager. Distinct tousled navy hair, no hat, orange hooded outdoor jacket, cream shorts, navy boots, small navy backpack and little telescope clipped at belt. Energetic and observant.

compass: Use case: illustration-story. Production layered toy compass illustration for a children's island adventure UI. Style reference is the illustrated treasure chest/compass; reference for linework and colors only. Create TWO isolated components side by side on a genuinely transparent landscape sheet with wide gutters. LEFT occupying left half: large circular old adventure compass FACE, perfectly front-on, round orange outer rim, thick organic navy outline, cream/white dial, simple navy decorative tick marks, a small round central pivot position, NO needle at all. No letters or numbers anywhere. RIGHT occupying right half: a matching separate long narrow double-ended compass NEEDLE pointing vertically UP, upper half orange, lower half navy, cream/navy rim and a small circular center pivot at EXACT midpoint. Needle must be symmetrical in its vertical extent about the pivot to permit rotation; no dial under the separate needle. These two cropped bitmap components will be layered with HTML to animate the needle, so keep face centered in left half, needle centered in right half, both upright and front-facing. Fixed palette ONLY #102B50 #FF5726 #FFFFFF #FFF1E5. Flat clean playful vector-like cartoon fills, thick navy contours, no perspective, shadows, gradients, lettering, labels, UI, sparkle rays or extra objects. Full composition and generous transparent padding around both components.
